comments.note: DownloadPercent uses integer division (BytesReceived * 100 / BytesTotal.Value). This is intentional truncation for display purposes and documented. Long overflow risk is negligible for real-world provisioning file sizes. If BytesReceived > BytesTotal, the result exceeds 100% — acceptable for a progress display.

The null-guard pattern `if (p.Message is not null) Message = p.Message;` is correct and idiomatic for the 'last non-null wins' semantics. [NotifyPropertyChangedFor] wiring on both _bytesReceived and _bytesTotal is the proper CommunityToolkit MVVM approach. No issues.
